notes.title: Update v1.25.1001
notes.content:
New
User's settings (such as volume and resolutions) are now saved across sessions.
Added an Exit Game button to the Main Menu.

Bug fixes
The Endless Trophy glitch, which prevented players from continuing, has been partially fixed.
